name: HWind Legacy Archive
model_or_instrument: HRD real-time hurricane wind analysis system (HWind)
size_as_stated: 85 TC events in the Northern Hemisphere (North Atlantic basin, 2003-2013/2014)

scales.note: HWind gridded surface wind fields at 0.05 degrees (~6 km) and 6-hr timesteps for North Atlantic tropical cyclones from 2003 to 2013 (11 years).
